lead_time_relative_to_departure: T - 90 to T - 150 min (mean approx 105 min)
operational_mechanics_and_feedback: Passengers enter security screening lanes; checkpoint throughput at hour t represents demand for flights departing in hours t+1, t+2, and t+3.
Physical identity verification, passenger divestiture, and body/baggage scanning.
Passengers transit sterile terminal concourse, visit concessions, and assemble at gate.
Federal security regulations and airline SOP require gate doors to close strictly 15 minutes before scheduled pushback.
Aircraft gate pushback and taxi-out; actual flight departure delays act as a downstream feedback indicator of terminal gate saturation.
